Keys 0-47 root 43 and 60-127 root 72: 20 ms of air (-50 dB noise) then an 8-harmonic tone decaying 12 dB/s, 4 s, onset marker at the -24 dB crossing, tail loop at 2.4 s (whole cycles, ~0.3 s). Keys 48-59 root 52: a looped tone in choke group 1 (grp 1, offBy 1). Release region (all keys): 1 kHz damper tone, rt_decay 3 dB/s. Noise region (keys 0-99): 60 ms key-off burst (noise regions trigger at note-off, level = the Noise knob).
